## Checklist

- [ ] The title follows Conventional Commits; for lint rule sets: `feat!` enables a rule or raises the minimum SDK, `feat` disables a rule or adds a file, `fix`/`docs` changes reasons or documentation.
- [ ] Code written by the contributors, without copying from third-party projects ([PROVENANCE.md](../PROVENANCE.md)).
- [ ] Tests cover the change.
